reference.title: Tutorial: Create and manage Cost Management exports (delivery layout and _manifest.json example)
reference.formal_schema_note: Microsoft does NOT publish a formal JSON Schema, OpenAPI model, or field table for the export manifest file. The only official definition is the worked example of _manifest.json reproduced in the tutorial, plus the REST properties partitionData and manifestFile. Columns with status verified-example-only are documented by example only and must not be treated as a normative schema.

additional_sources.title: Exports - Create Or Update (REST API 2025-03-01) - partitionData property
Exports - Get Execution History (REST API 2025-03-01) - manifestFile property

delivery.partition_granularity: by size, not by row count; each uncompressed file under 1 GB
delivery.partition_data: always enabled and cannot be disabled
delivery.overwrite_behavior: OverwritePreviousReport (single RunID per month folder) or CreateNewReport (multiple RunIDs)

columns.name: manifestVersion
columns.description: Version of the manifest format. Official example value: "2024-04-01". No published list of manifest versions.

columns.name: byteCount
columns.description: Total byte count of the dataset at the top level; byte count of a single partition inside blobs[]. Official example: 8032.

columns.name: blobCount
columns.description: Number of partitions (blobs) in the dataset. Official example: 1.

columns.name: dataRowCount
columns.description: Data row count of the dataset at the top level; row count of a single partition inside blobs[]. Official example: 36.

columns.name: exportConfig
columns.description: Export configuration in effect for this run.

columns.name: exportConfig.exportName
columns.description: Export name. Official example: "sample". Correlates with ExportName in the blob path.

columns.name: exportConfig.resourceId
columns.description: ARM resource ID of the export object. Official example: /providers/Microsoft.Billing/billingAccounts/1234567/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/exports/sample.

columns.name: exportConfig.dataVersion
columns.description: Dataset schema version. Official example: "2023-05-01". Maps to dataSet.configuration.dataVersion in the API.

columns.name: exportConfig.apiVersion
columns.description: Export API version used. Official example: "2023-07-01-preview".

columns.name: exportConfig.type
columns.description: ExportType of the dataset. Official example: "ReservationRecommendations". Maps to definition.type in the API.

columns.name: exportConfig.timeFrame
columns.description: TimeframeType of the export. Official example: "MonthToDate". Maps to definition.timeframe in the API. Note the API spells it lowercase timeframe.

columns.name: exportConfig.granularity
columns.description: GranularityType of the dataset. Official example: null. Maps to dataSet.granularity in the API.

columns.name: deliveryConfig
columns.description: Delivery configuration in effect for this run.

columns.name: deliveryConfig.partitionData
columns.description: Same as the REST property of the same name: "If set to true, exported data will be partitioned by size and placed in a blob directory together with a manifest file." Official example: true.

columns.name: deliveryConfig.dataOverwriteBehavior
columns.description: DataOverwriteBehaviorType: overwrite behavior for data of the same month in the customer storage account. Official example: "OverwritePreviousReport". API default: "CreateNewReport".

columns.name: deliveryConfig.fileFormat
columns.description: Delivered file format. Official example: "Csv". Named format in the export API, not fileFormat.

columns.name: deliveryConfig.compressionMode
columns.description: Compression scheme. Official example: "None". Portal offers None, Gzip (CSV) and Snappy (Parquet); the REST run history example uses lowercase "gzip".

columns.name: deliveryConfig.containerUri
columns.description: Resource ID of the destination storage account. The official example contains a space after /subscriptions/ exactly as published; see the divergences section of the .md spec. API destination property is named resourceId.

columns.name: deliveryConfig.rootFolderPath
columns.description: StorageDirectory (root folder) of the export. Official example: "folder". Maps to deliveryInfo.destination.rootFolderPath.

columns.name: runInfo
columns.description: Run information for this export run.

columns.name: runInfo.executionType
columns.description: Run execution type. Official example: "OnDemand"; the REST run history also uses "Scheduled".

columns.name: runInfo.submittedTime
columns.description: Time the run was submitted. Official example carries 7 fractional-second digits: 2025-03-21T21:04:06.5234447Z.

columns.name: runInfo.runId
columns.description: Run identifier; this is the [RunID] segment of the blob path. Official example: bbac73f1-9a05-4de6-84ab-c72b568a03b4.

columns.name: runInfo.startDate
columns.datetime_format: ISO 8601 without UTC designator in the official example
columns.description: Start date of the run period. Official example has NO timezone designator: "2025-03-01T00:00:00".

columns.name: runInfo.endDate
columns.description: End date of the run period. Official example: "2025-03-21T00:00:00Z".

columns.name: blobs
columns.description: List of partitions. Each file partition has headers and contains only a subset of the full dataset.

columns.name: blobs[].blobName
columns.description: Authoritative name/path of the partition. Official example: " folder/sample/ 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/part0.csv". Documentation instructs to always use the manifest and never to infer partition names.

columns.name: blobs[].byteCount
columns.description: Partition size in bytes. Official example: 8032.

columns.name: blobs[].dataRowCount
columns.description: Partition data row count. Official example: 36.

columns.name: manifestFile
columns.description: ExportRun.manifestFile: "The manifest file location(URI location) for the exported files." Returned by the run history API, not contained in the manifest file. Official examples use the path segment "manifestfile".

columns.name: properties.partitionData
columns.description: Export request/response property that creates the manifest file alongside the partitioned data.

columns.name: fileName
columns.description: ExportRun.fileName: name of the exported file. Example uses the pattern {ExportName}_{RunId}.csv, which differs from the manifest example pattern part<N>.csv.

columns.name: runSettings.partitionData
columns.description: Partitioning setting in effect for the run. Example: true.

columns.name: runSettings.format
columns.description: Format in effect for the run. Example: "Csv".

columns.name: runSettings.compressionMode
columns.description: Compression in effect for the run. Example: "gzip" (lowercase).

columns.name: runSettings.dataOverwriteBehavior
columns.description: Overwrite behavior in effect for the run. Example: "OverwritePreviousReport".

columns.name: executionType
columns.description: Run execution type: "OnDemand" or "Scheduled".

columns.name: submittedBy
columns.description: Identifier of the entity that triggered the export. For on-demand runs it is the user email; for scheduled runs it is System.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Last known status of the export run. Example: "Completed".

columns.name: processingStartTime
columns.datetime_format: ISO 8601 UTC with fractional seconds and Z
columns.description: Time when the export was picked up to run. Example: 2018-08-03T07:52:16.9123797Z.

columns.name: processingEndTime
columns.datetime_format: ISO 8601 UTC with fractional seconds and Z
columns.description: Time when the export run finished. Example: 2018-08-03T07:52:28.0373318Z.

unverified.name: exportConfig.beginDate
unverified.reason: Not present in the only official _manifest.json example. Microsoft publishes no manifest field table or JSON Schema, so its existence and format cannot be proven. Not generated.

unverified.name: exportConfig.endDate
unverified.reason: Not present in the only official _manifest.json example. Same reasoning as exportConfig.beginDate. Not generated.

unverified.name: aggregate semantics of top-level byteCount/dataRowCount when blobCount > 1
unverified.reason: The official example has blobCount=1 so top-level and partition values coincide. Documentation never states whether top-level values are sums over partitions.

unverified.name: complete value sets for exportConfig.type / exportConfig.timeFrame / exportConfig.granularity
unverified.reason: No retrievable enumeration table was found on the consulted official pages; only values appearing in official examples are proven.

unverified.name: manifest schema stability across manifestVersion values
unverified.reason: No published manifest schema version list or changelog, so future field sets cannot be proven.

unverified.name: manifest for non-partitioned exports
unverified.reason: Documentation ties the manifest to partitioned data and states partitioning can no longer be disabled; no example or path is documented for a non-partitioned export.
